stories.title: Im Sung-jae misses out on PGA Tour playoff finale for 1st time
stories.summary: For the first time in his PGA Tour career, Im Sung-jae will not get to play in the playoff finale in Atlanta. Im tied for 10th place at the BMW Championship, the second leg of the FedEx Cup playoffs, at Bellerive Country Club in St. Louis on Sunday (local time), with a four-round total of eight-under 272. It was Im's second consecutive top-10 finish, but it was not enough to put him inside the top 30 in the FedEx Cup standings and send him to the Tour Championship in Atlanta to close out the playoffs. Im ranked 40th in FedEx Cup points entering the BMW Championship and needed to at least tie for sixth place to crack the top 30. He ended up in 37th place instead. Im was tied for fourth place at the halfway mark after rounds of 67 and 64, but faded over the weekend by shooting 70 and 71. In the final round, Im had a birdie and an eagle, but also four bogeys. Im had played at each of the past seven editions of the Tour Championship, dating back to his rookie season in 2018-19. Im missed the first two months of this season while recovering from a wrist injury and has had an uncharacteristically inconsistent campaign. His late-season push, which included four consecutive top-15 finishes, proved to be too little and too late for the 28-year-old. Two other South Koreans will tee off at the Tour Championship at East Lake Golf Club starting Thursday. Kim Si-woo tied for 33rd at the BWM Championship at two-under 278 and slipped from fourth to fifth in FedEx Cup rankings -- the highest position by a player without a victory this season.

stories.title: Landslide at waste mound in Guinea capital kills 30, government says
stories.summary: Dump site in Conakry, which minister had just promised to move, collapsed after heavy rain in west African state A ⁠landslide at a huge waste dump in Guinea’s capital has killed 30 people, the government said on Sunday, after heavy rains overnight prompted it to ⁠collapse, engulfing nearby tents and shacks. The incident occurred less than a week after the government announced plans to close the ⁠site and relocate the waste because of the threat it posed, especially during the rainy season, which causes landslides and fatal flash ⁠floods each year in crowded, underdeveloped cities across parts of West Africa. stories.title: The Mercosur-Singapore trade agreement reaches Argentina's Congress
stories.summary: Argentina's Chamber of Deputies will on Wednesday take up ratification of the free trade agreement between Mercosur and Singapore, signed in December 2023 and still awaiting parliamentary approval. It is the first trade treaty the bloc has concluded with a Southeast Asian country.
